description: This file implements the DnsOverHttpsConfig class, which manages DNS over HTTPS server configurations, including parsing from JSON or string templates, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig
classes.description: Represents DNS over HTTPS configuration, including server list, parsing, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or template group into a DnsOverHttpsConfig object.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromTemplates
methods.description: Creates a configuration from a list of server templates, validating each.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromTemplatesForTesting
methods.description: Creates a configuration from server templates, used for testing.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromStringLax
methods.description: Parses a string into a configuration, attempting JSON first, then templates.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration to a string, either as templates or JSON.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::ToValue
methods.description: Converts the configuration into a dictionary value for JSON serialization.
